W6 after E054. Time ≈ 0.1 s fixed + steps × per-step cost. Per-step cost is pixel-proportional compute plus a bandwidth-bound part (BN/GELU/pointwise, ~27% of a 32 px step). Tip E049: 5.198 s, 0.7535 on seeds 0–2. E053 read 5.075 s and 0.7562; E054 read 4.989 s and 0.7499.

Mechanisms and support:
1. Accuracy rises slowly with optimizer steps, about 1.5–2.5 s/pp. Step, epoch and sample cuts trade near the dial (E020, E031, E040, E041, E045, E048).
2. Early low resolution is nearly free (E026, E033). The 32 px tail carries accuracy (E011, E018, E024).
3. Late backward truncation saves more than its MAC share, because frozen blocks also skip BN/GELU backward, the optimizer update and Lookahead traffic (E028, E036, E046, E049, E053). Group 2 tolerates earlier freezing (E053 showed no cliff). Group 1 is different. It needs steady training and some 32 px exposure (E037, E054). E054 lost about 0.35 pp against E049 even though group 1 still trained on half the steps. So the stem is sensitive to the number of its updates. A freeze at 71% would probably sit between E036 and E037, with a loss of about 0.1–0.2 pp.
4. Averaging, LS, warm-up, Lookahead-interval, BN-recalibration and batch-split tweaks are null or negative. The recipe is near a local optimum.
5. Math-identical systems work is worth 1–2% each. About 2.5% of GPU time is outside the step graphs.
6. wd ×0.5 helped about 0.2 pp (E016).
7. Architecture surgery on high-resolution work (E051) loses accuracy faster than it saves time.
8. ReLU may save 1–3% of time. Its accuracy effect is unknown, probably −0.1 to −0.3 pp.
9. Build-to-build kernel reselection moves the 3-seed mean by ±0.3 pp. Time noise is ±0.04 s. The population mean is about 0.752–0.754, so the bar is barely cleared.

Misses: trims and group-2 freezes yielded more time than I forecast. Accuracy noise is wide, so I keep ranges about ±0.35 pp wide.

Unsure: the true tip mean, selection bias, PCIe transfer, whether the group-2 dose curve extends further, and the size of the stem's 32 px cliff.

forecasts.reason: The group-1 freeze moves 4% earlier, which saves about 0.05–0.08 s. The accuracy loss is probably small to moderate, so the cliff is not settled.
The offline step probably projects a saving under 3% because Inductor already fuses GELU backward cheaply, so there is likely no run. If it is run, the saving is small and accuracy is slightly lower.
The stack likely uses the group-2 85% freeze plus a top-up. The intermittent stem failed, so it is dropped. Time is about 4% below E049, and accuracy is at the noise floor.

cruxes: Is the stem's loss a threshold effect (the number of 32 px updates) or a linear dose? E054 and E037 point to a cliff, and I085 settles it.
Does ReLU's backward actually save at least 3% of train time under Inductor?
What is the true unselected mean of the tip, and will it clear 0.75 on the judge's own build?
